metadata.description: Optimal bidding strategy derived from MDP backward induction + analytical approximations

rule_1_budget_allocation.description: Allocate budget across stages based on SP value
rule_1_budget_allocation.S2: 35% of budget (~$3,500) for 2-3 wins — swing stage
rule_1_budget_allocation.adjustment: If behind on SP, increase allocation by 20%. If ahead, decrease by 20%.

rule_2_marginal_sp_value.description: SP value varies by tournament phase and position

rule_3_bid_sizing.description: Bid multiplier based on strategic context

rule_4_skip_conditions.description: When to skip rather than bid
rule_4_skip_conditions.comfortable_lead: SP gap >= 3, tokens needed = 0, early period

rule_5_vickrey_insight.description: Vickrey auction: you pay 2nd-highest price, not your bid
rule_5_vickrey_insight.implication: Bid your true valuation, not what you think will win
rule_5_vickrey_insight.optimal: Bid = marginal SP value × token value, capped by budget
